"use strict";
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.withTeardownDeadline = withTeardownDeadline;
const contracts_1 = require("@platform/contracts");
/** A wedged force removal must settle so durable cleanup can attempt it again. */
async function withTeardownDeadline(removal, sandboxId) {
    let timer;
    const timeout = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new contracts_1.SandboxProviderError(contracts_1.SandboxProviderErrorCode.TIMEOUT, `任务 ${sandboxId} 的运行环境没有在限定时间内删除。`, undefined, true));
        }, 15_000);
    });
    try {
        await Promise.race([removal, timeout]);
    }
    finally {
        if (timer)
            clearTimeout(timer);
    }
}
